description: Hand-written synthetic shape (i): the happy exact-sample1 baseline run, one conforming Contract v1 response per Analysis Unit of the sample1 Coverage Manifest (8 units over 97 blocks), keyed by unit ordinal and request digest. Every name, synopsis, event, claim, and note is public synthetic placeholder text; the only manuscript-derived facts are the block identities filled from {{block:N}} at replay. Units 1, 3, and 5 deliberately disagree so the deterministic pass reports one alias collision, one entity-kind divergence, and one setting-claim divergence. A second unit-1 entry carries the digest unit 1 derives after J-04's acknowledged edit, so one identity serves the three update modes too. One unit-ordinal-0 entry answers the cross-unit reduction over the eight-unit closed set; two more answer the assurance sampling turn, whose findings are both anchored in unit 1 — one before that edit, one after — naming each by listed position {{ref:N}}, upholding the first and downgrading the second.
